oneLiner: Turn rough status bullets into polished updates—one for execs, one for the team.
problem: Writing status updates is slow and repetitive. People either overshare with leadership or undershare with their team, wasting time reformatting the same information for different audiences.
targetUser: Busy individual contributors, tech leads, and project managers who send regular status updates to both leadership and their teams.
coreFlow: Paste or type rough status bullets
Choose audience versions to generate (Exec, Team, or both)
Edit inline with tone presets (Concise, Detailed, Casual)
Copy, export, or share the final update

screens.name: Input
screens.purpose: Capture rough notes via paste, type, or quick bullet entry with audience selection.

screens.name: Dual Draft View
screens.purpose: Show side-by-side exec and team versions with inline editing and tone controls.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Browse, search, and reuse past updates, with audience-tagged versions.

screens.name: Templates & Preferences
screens.purpose: Save reusable formats, default tones, and recurring update structures.

screens.name: Share & Export
screens.purpose: Send via email, Slack, or copy to clipboard with per-audience formatting.

outOfScope: Automatic task or ticket tracking integrations
